description: This file defines Express route handlers for document-related operations such as listing, creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, inviting collaborators, removing collaborators, and real-time sync. It also includes Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing all documents visible to the user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new document with specified title and content.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific document by ID, if access is allowed.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the title or content of a specific document.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a document; only owner can perform this action.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Invites a user to collaborate on a document.

methods.name: removeCollaborator
methods.description: Removes a collaborator from a document.

methods.name: syncContent
methods.description: Synchronizes real-time content updates to a document.
